# CE23-12 MSA contract

MSA = Repeatability_verifier AND Reproducibility_environment AND MutationSensitivity AND
ClassificationAgreement: before benchmark results are trusted, the benchmark itself is measured.
Each operator MSA question maps to a property; each property has at least one court. "Status today"
is the executor-side observation of the scan lanes (O, not a receipt): MSA_ALIVE for the executor is
successor work and is not claimed here. The design-side measurement system (the benchmark design
court's own instruments) is measured by `courts/CE23-12-MSAContract.sh` on every run.

## Properties (7)

| property | operator falsifier (committed proposition) | courts |
|---|---|---|
| cached-state / environment reproducibility | A classification that changes with cached state falsifies MSA environment reproducibility. | 2 |
| independent-verifier / classification agreement | Disagreement of independent verifiers falsifies MSA classification agreement. | 1 |
| membership boundary (near-miss vs KNOWN) | A near-miss admitted KNOWN by the membership test falsifies the admission boundary. | 4 |
| mutation sensitivity | A corrupted output that passes falsifies MSA mutation sensitivity. | 2 |
| ordering invariance | An answer that changes with benchmark ordering falsifies MSA ordering invariance. | 1 |
| stale receipt detection | A stale receipt that passes falsifies MSA stale-receipt detection. | 1 |
| verifier repeatability | The same artifact receiving different verdicts falsifies MSA repeatability. | 1 |
